title: Refuse MCP update and handoff fields that the selected action does not use, instead of silently discarding them
outcome: Refuse MCP update and handoff fields that the selected action does not use, instead of silently discarding them
acceptance: For the MCP update and handoff tools, every supplied field is either consumed by the selected action or refused before any mutation, with a refusal naming the field and the action (for example update action=cancel with title, or handoff action=accept with to, summary, reason or ttl_seconds)
Valid action-specific fields and existing refusal codes are unchanged, and tests cover at least one refused unrelated field per action family
